semantics.result_rule: Response derives from exact operation result/error identity.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive internal error/data fields are omitted/redacted according to policy.
semantics.stream_rule: Streaming/chunked response semantics are explicit where supported.
semantics.effect_rule: Response serialization has no hidden application effect.
semantics.authority_rule: Response receipt grants no new authority.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.
